name: @intellectual-frontiers/test
description: Tests that run unchanged under bun test and node --test, and are recorded as evidence by their own code: registration on node:test, the assertions under short plain names, proves (which names the requirements a test proves), only, steps, and the record of every test as an OpenTelemetry span and log record on the installation record.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../ts/mizan/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
